uniform_gate.description: A resolved physical-rim crossing requires an upward alpha>=0.5 component covering at least 95% of one rim face and cumulative positive integral(alpha*Uz dA dt) of at least one adjacent normal-direction finite-volume cell.
uniform_gate.stored_field_basis: cell-centred alpha.water and U sampled on the rim plane; this is an alpha-weighted advective-flow audit, not a recovered OpenFOAM face alphaPhi ledger
